_comment: Magnetomech (GROMACS CG modulus -> field deformation). Reads the CG-derived Young's modulus and computes the deformation of a magnetic-nanoparticle-loaded SELP sample under an applied magnetic field. See code/magnetomech/ and backend/tasktype/magnetomech/. Modulus: 'modulusMode' = affine(default)/phantom/scanlan_affine/explicit; when 'explicit', set 'modulusKpa'. Leave 'modulusPath' null to auto-use the CG handoff summary.
